name: Spinach
description: Soft leafy green cooked across all four cuisines.

histamine.note: Surprisingly high histamine for a 'healthy' green.

nutrition.highlight: the iron is real; so is the oxalate that blocks it

guna.note: Aged, cured or fermented — the condition the texts call tamasic, whatever the ingredient started as.

effects.note: Spinach is one of the most nitrate-dense vegetables grown, and randomised crossover trials using a cooked-spinach-sized dose found measurable drops in blood pressure within hours, through the same nitrate-to-nitric-oxide pathway as beetroot. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
